critical_code_review_comments: MatterNotes.save() sends PUT even when text is identical to n.text; the disabled state on the save button only checks !text.trim(), not whether text changed. Backend correctly no-ops but the UX still shows 'Note updated' toast on unchanged saves. Consider comparing text.trim() === n.text.trim() to disable Save or skip the request.

Save button in NoteItem doesn't warn if text was reset to empty — the disabled={!text.trim()} handles it, but pressing Save with whitespace-only content is possible if user has trailing spaces (currently trimmed server-side; UI still trims via text.trim() before send — OK).
Delete uses window.confirm() which is not stylable and inconsistent with the app's shadcn dialog usage. Consider replacing with an AlertDialog for design consistency.
load() in MatterNotes re-fetches every time onChanged fires, causing a brief flicker on the note list after each edit/delete. Optimistic update or SWR-style stale-while-revalidate would be smoother.
